title: Guest Service Associate- Courtyard by Marriott Vitthalapur
description:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26133208  
**Job Category**Food and Beverage & Culinary  
**Location**One Marriott Drive, Need Address, Vitthalapur 382120, India  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Non-Management  

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

*At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*

At Courtyard, we’re passionate about better serving the needs of travelers everywhere. It’s what inspired us to create the first hotel designed specifically for business travelers, and it’s why the Courtyard experience today empowers our guests, no matter the purpose of their trip. We’re looking for achievers who are passionate about providing a guest experience that goes above and beyond, enjoy being part of a small yet ambitious team, and love learning how to always improve – all while having fun.

In joining Courtyard, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

title: Center Manager- Beauty and Wellness
description:
* **We are looking for a high-performing, sales-driven, and operationally sound \*\*Center Manager\*\* to lead our INSTITUTE. The ideal candidate will be a strong closer who handles consultations, provides customized costing, and performs \*\*on-table/spot closing\*\*. You will be responsible for the entire journeyfrom converting warm leads via phone to managing walk-ins, coordinating medical teams, and maintaining smooth operations.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales, Consultation & "On-Table" Conversion**

**On-Table Closing:\*\* Conduct face-to-face consultations assessment to explain plans, deliver customized costing/pricing options, and close the sale immediately.**

**Lead Conversion:\*\* Call prospective/new leads, understand their requirements, effectively pitch our services, and convince them to visit the CENTER for a Consultation (CS).**

**Rigorous Follow-Ups (FUP):\*\* Maintain a strict follow-up pipeline for all non-converted walk-ins and inquiries to bring them back for booking.**

**Lead Generation:\*\* Actively identify opportunities to create new leads through local marketing initiatives, patient referrals, and networking.**

**2. Center Operations & Hospitality**

**Center Administration:\*\* Take full ownership of the centers daily operations, ensuring the cENTER'S maintains premium standards of hygiene, decorum, and premium hospitality.**

**Guest Relations:\*\* Manage walk-in patients warmly, ensure minimal wait times, and deliver an exceptional customer experience.**

**Team Coordination:\*\* Smoothly coordinate with and Front-Desk Executives regarding daily appointments,**

**3. CRM & Reporting**

**Data Management:\*\* Accurately update interactions, visit details, follow-up statuses, and booking stages in the CRM system daily.**

**\* \*\*Sales Tracking:\*\* Maintain complete records of daily walk-ins, conversion rates, revenue collected, and pending pipelines for management review.**

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹48,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: System Support Administrator
description:
SUMMARY:

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled System Support Administrator with around 1\.5 years of experience to join our IT team. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in IT support, system troubleshooting, basic networking, and user administration. Candidates who have completed relevant IT courses or certifications and are looking to grow their career in system and network administration are encouraged to apply.

The candidate will be responsible for providing day\-to\-day technical support, maintaining IT systems, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and assisting with network and security\-related tasks.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field is preferred., Relevant certifications and practical experience may also be considered.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

1 to 2 years of experience in IT Support, System Support, Desktop Support, or a similar role.

Good understanding of Windows operating systems and basic troubleshooting.

Basic knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, and firewalls.

Basic knowledge of computer hardware, peripherals, printers, and troubleshooting.

Familiarity with user account and access management.

Basic understanding of antivirus, endpoint security, and system updates.

Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to document technical issues and resolutions clearly.

Ability to work independently as well as with a team.

CERTIFICATIONS:

CompTIA A\+

CompTIA Network\+

Microsoft Windows / Microsoft 365 Administration

CCNA or basic networking certification

Linux Fundamentals / Linux Administration

IT Support / System Administration courses

Any other relevant IT infrastructure or networking certification

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Provide first\-level technical support to employees for hardware, software, operating system, and connectivity\-related issues. Diagnose and resolve common desktop, laptop, printer, application, and operating system problems. Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, software applications, and IT hardware. Set up computers, user accounts, email accounts, peripherals, and other IT resources for new and existing employees. Perform routine system updates, software installations, patches, and basic backups. Monitor system health and performance and escalate complex issues when required. Assist with the configuration and maintenance of network devices such as routers, switches, access points, and firewalls. Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and internet connectivity issues. Assist in maintaining basic network and endpoint security, including antivirus, firewall, VPN, and access\-control configurations. Manage user access and permissions in accordance with company policies. Maintain an inventory of IT assets, systems, and software licenses. Maintain proper documentation of support tickets, technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions. Follow IT security, backup, access\-control, and data protection procedures. Coordinate with senior IT/System Administrators or external vendors for issues requiring advanced technical support. Provide basic guidance and training to users on IT systems, applications, and security best practices.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

1 to 2 years of practical IT/System Support experience. Strong interest in System Administration, Networking, and IT Infrastructure. Willingness to learn and work with new technologies. Good analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Responsible, proactive, and customer\-focused approach. Candidates with relevant courses, certifications, labs, or hands\-on projects will be considered positively.

20,000\.00 \- 30,000\.00

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
